title: Nintendo Switch Docked Share by Month
app: Jellyfin, Emby, Steam, Steam Deck logs, Xbox and Nintendo exports, Tautulli, AntennaPod, RetroArch, and the *arr stack via official APIs, local databases, webhook payloads, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=nintendo:play
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats count(eval(mode="docked")) as docked_sessions, count as total_sessions by player _time
| eval docked_share_pct=round(100*docked_sessions/total_sessions,1)
| where total_sessions>=5
| sort - _time
description: Uses Nintendo play exports telemetry to monitor how much of Switch time was docked versus handheld in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for household play-style changes across the month, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Nintendo play exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how much of Switch time was docked versus handheld so you can spot household play-style changes across the month before it becomes annoying.
